SY421
Advanced Sociology of Mental Health
0.5 Credit
An advanced analysis in the sociology of mental health and illness. Through engagement with sociological perspectives, the
course
explores the social and political implications of the theory and practice of the mental health sciences.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY210
(or SY204*) or
SY213
or
SY232
or permission of the department.
Exclusions
SY452w.
